author: IcyCode
body: Voting rewards. It has recently been changed down from 25 or 28 I think to 18. Why? 18 EXP is not worth it at all. It's because of all the complaints about it being too OP and far too much. So if you think it is too OP don't vote simple as. It has to be a reward that should be worth while getting. Else our popularity is going to go down... Think new people will vote once and only get 18XP and never vote again. Change it back
